description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single ranged attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Physical Blink 1] and [Dark Assassination Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Dark Assassination Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Dark Assassination after using a Dark ability
